mentions.name: wheretodrink.beer
mentions.description: A curated directory collecting and cataloging craft beer venues from around the world, with maps and "where to go next" sections for each venue. Planned additions include user accounts for venue bucket lists and endorsements, plus one-click verification emails sent to venues to keep listings current.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Most effort on https://wheretodrink.beer, collecting and cataloging craft beer venues from around the world. 
No ambition of being exhaustive, but aiming for a curated and substantial list. Since last month I've added a couple of minor things like maps and "where to go next" sections for each venue.
